lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively consistent across the mid-section, narrowing slightly towards the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the fifth vertical line from the anterior, located at mid-torso height.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first and second anterior lines and the final two posterior lines terminate before reaching the ventral fringe; the eighth line appears as a shorter dashed segment.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two primary high-contrast spots are visible on the lower haunch area, with one smaller satellite spot located slightly lower on the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two primary spots on the upper hind limb align on a semi-horizontal axis.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit an initial outward vector of approximately 45 degrees from the base, transitioning into a medial lyrate curvature towards the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 2.5 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Light-colored ivory tips occupy approximately the top 15 percent of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white horizontal chevron across the bridge of the muzzle and two distinct white patches on the lower neck and throat region.
